---
name: "nf-core/rastair2/mbias"
description: "Measure methylation by position in read (M-bias) of 5mC->T converted\n\
  paired-end reads with rastair version 2, and suggest how many bases to\nignore at\
  \ each read end. Runs `rastair per-read` (options in `ext.args`,\ne.g. `--region`)\
  \ and then `rastair mbias` on its output (options in\n`ext.args2`). Writes an HTML\
  \ report and, for each contig with enough data,\na cutoffs file to pass to rastair2/call.\n\
  Non-commercial licence: see the rastair tool description.\n"
keywords:
- "methylation"
- "mbias"
- "taps"
- "5-base"
- "qc"
- "trimming"
tools:
- rastair:
    description: "Simultaneous detection of genetic variants and methylated positions\
      \ from\nTAPS+, Illumina 5-base or other 5mC->T converted sequencing data.\n\
      Licensing: rastair version 2 and newer is free for non-commercial research\n\
      use only. Commercial use (including providing paid services or developing\n\
      products) requires a licence from Oxford University Innovation\n(enquiries@innovation.ox.ac.uk,\
      \ reference 24811). Run `rastair license` for\nthe full terms. Publications\
      \ using results must include the notice\n\"Copyright © 2025, University of Oxford\"\
      .\n"
    homepage: "https://www.rastair.com"
    documentation: "https://docs.rastair.com"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/bsbludwig/rastair"
    licence:
    - "LicenseRef-NonCommercial"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information. Reads must be paired-end:\n\
        `single_end: true` is an error.\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1', single_end:false ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Coordinate-sorted BAM or CRAM file of 5mC->T converted paired-end\
        \ reads"
      pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3462"
  - index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index of the BAM or CRAM file"
      pattern: "*.{bai,csi,crai}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3327"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA, used by `rastair per-read`"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}{,.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "samtools faidx index of the reference FASTA. Staged next to the\
        \ FASTA,\nwhere rastair finds it; it is not passed on the command line.\n"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
output:
  html:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information. e.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`"
    - '*.mbias.html':
        type: "file"
        description: "HTML report with M-bias plots per contig and the suggested cutoffs\
          \ drawn\non them. V-bias and GC plots are not produced.\n"
        pattern: "*.mbias.html"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2331"
  cutoffs:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information. e.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`"
    - '*.cutoffs.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "One file per contig, `<prefix>.<contig>.cutoffs.txt`. Line 1\
          \ is the value\nfor rastair2/call `--nOT`, line 2 for `--nOB`, each as\n\
          `r1_start,r1_end,r2_start,r2_end` bases to ignore. Restrict the run to one\n\
          contig or region with `--region` in `ext.args` to get a single file:\nthis\
          \ also keeps memory down, as the report loads every read in range.\nContigs\
          \ with too little data get no file, and if no read in range has a\nCpG there\
          \ are no cutoffs files at all (the report says so), so callers\ncan fall\
          \ back to no trimming.\n"
        pattern: "*.cutoffs.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_rastair:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - rastair:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - rastair --version | sed 's/^rastair //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
